title: Travel procurement and reimbursement cheat sheet
content:
Purpose: quick personal scratchpad to run point on APAC partner summit logistics, vendor payment reminders, and fast reimbursement steps. Not official policy — use Finance Confluence page for final answers.

Top priorities before travel:
- Expense card vs personal: try expense card (Redwood corporate CC) for hotels, AV, catering. If card unavailable, pay personal and submit expense within 7 days.
- Scan receipts immediately: use Expensify app (project tag: EVT-APAC-2025) or take phone photos and upload to Drive under /events/receipts/<person>-YYYYMMDD. Include merchant copy + credit card statement line if personal.
- Per diem reminder: APAC per diem is JPY 10,000/day equivalent for meals unless conference provides meals (mark exceptions). Put currency conversions in expense memo (rate source: XE.com).

Vendor & on-site contacts (quick dial):
- AV: BrightStage Events — contact: Aisha Rahman, +61 420 555 112, aisha@brightstage.com.au (PO# RS-AV-118). Ask for: onsite tech 1 hour before show, backup dongles, spare lav mic.
- Catering: Lotus Catering — contact: David Kim, +65 9123 3344, david.kim@lotuscatering.sg (invoice to bill@redwood.com, reference: LOTUS-EVT-221). Confirm vegetarian counts 48h prior.
- Shuttle / ground: CityShuttle Logistics — contact: Mei Tan, +852 6222 0007, ops@cityshuttle.hk (use corporate rate; set pickup 7:30am hotel lobby).
- Hotel billing (preferred direct billing to Redwood): Ops billing desk: reservations@grandcentral-sg.com. When booking, put folio to: Redwood Inference (Attn: Finance AP) — include PO RS-HOTEL-45. For incidental charges do NOT allow room to be charged to Redwood card; guests settle incidentals on checkout and claim separately.

Invoice handling notes:
- Invoices should reference PO if available. PO mapping: Dedicated events (PO RS-DED-xxx), Hosted/Marketing (PO RS-HOST-xxx), Field Ops general (PO RS-OPS-xxx).
- Receipt format accepted: PDF invoices, scanned receipts, merchant emails. Every invoice needs: vendor name, date, line items, total, VAT/GST breakdown if applicable, bank wire instructions if >USD 5k.
- Preferred payment: vendor invoice to bill@redwood.com with PDF attachment; cc events@redwood.com. If vendor sends unpaid invoice to rep, forward to finance-invoices@redwood.com and note PO and event code.
- SLA: get vendor invoice within 14 days post-event; follow up after 7 days if missing.

Expense coding cheat sheet (for quick memos on expense submissions):
- Travel (air/train): code EVT-TRAVEL + project: EVT-APAC-2025
- Hotel: code EVT-HOTEL
- Meals (non-per diem): EVT-MEALS (specify guest list if client-paid meal)
- AV/Capture/Streaming: EVT-TECH-AV
- Vendor professional services (on-site staff): CONSULT-OPS

Quick reimbursement email template (paste into Expensify note or email):
Subject: Expense Reimbursement — <Your Name> — EVT-APAC-2025 — <dates>
Body: Hi Finance, submitting expenses for APAC summit <dates>. Attached: receipts + card statement. Total reimbursement: <amount> <currency>. Code: EVT-APAC-2025 / EVT-TRAVEL (or specify). Request ACH to last used account on file. Thank you — <Your name>.

Packing & on-site micro checklist (things I forget):
- HDMI (mini + full), USB-C hub, spare adapter, battery bank, power strip (surge protected)
- Printed vendor POs, signed copies (if required), physical name badges for staff
- Blank M&As for receipts (sticky notes with expense codes)

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Confirm BrightStage final quote: waiting on line-item breakdown for "streaming encoding" (email sent 2025-05-02, follow-up scheduled 2025-05-09).
- Lotus Catering: confirm kosher meal option — action: Jordan to confirm by 2025-05-06.
- Hotel: double-check breakfast included for group rate (Maya to call reservations by 2025-05-07).

Unresolved/notes-to-self (messy):
- If Uber receipts are missing (personal travel), get trip history PDF from account and attach to expense.
- For cash tips (local currency): standardize tip note in expense and convert at day rate, add short note: "tip — local taxi".
- Keep a 3-month buffer folder of event receipts on Drive for audit (Finance wants 90 days easily accessible).

Slack quick links: #events-ops (ops questions), #travel-expenses (finance Qs), #field-contacts (urgent on-site).

Final reminder before leaving: check corporate card limits, lock hotel incidentals policy with guest instructions, and set autoresponder for 48 hours.

End of scratchpad — drop items here during travel and clean up to Confluence playbook after event.
_notes: user scratchpad style, intentionally informal and fragmentary
